text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way to the track for training—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hup... hup...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Uuu, I can't reach it...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Rice.
What're you doing jumping up and down like that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, Gold Ship-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, the wind blew my handkerchief away,
and it got caught on a tree branch.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see.
I thought you were practicing jumping double dutch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I haven't been able to reach it at all...
If only Rice were taller, I could grab it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, the Rice I know
ain't the type to whine about her height, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I watched ya properly, ya know... Even when
you kept losing races, you kept running anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Facing forward toward the goal you're aiming for—
never giving up is your greatest strength!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up! Jump!
Grab that handkerchief! Grab your dreams!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah!
Rice won't give up and will do her very best!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower continued to jump desperately
toward the handkerchief caught in the branch—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I got it...?! 
Rice reached the handkerchief!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Amazing, amazing! Congrats!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fueh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone realized it, a crowd of onlookers had gathered,
sending cheers of celebration to Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Th-Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How's that, Rice? Your challenge
moved all these people to tears!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
An unyielding spirit... the guts to keep challenging...!
You're the greatest horse girl ever!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... I don't really understand, but
if everyone is happy, then I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Then lend me that handkerchief!
Next up, let's challenge it 50cm higher!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fueeeh?! But Rice just got it back...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The importance of continuing to strive toward a goal—
this holds true for me as a Trainer as well.
